A9Analogue

Ring Modulator

Metallic tones from two signals

Multiplies carrier and modulator. Instead of the two tones you hear their sum and difference frequencies: metallic, bell-like or robotic.

  • DEPTH fades from the carrier to pure ring modulation
  • AM / MIX switch sets the character of the control range
  • DEPTH is CV controllable
